Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
Hi again, here's my other question of the day. Is it allowable for
a minion with a weapon with a maneuver attached (44 Mag, Zip Gun, etc) to
use that maneuver even if they are not getting a strike that round? For
example, if they are in the first round of a Fast Reaction or Hidden
Lurker combat, can they use a gun to go to long? Since normally using
a maneuver on a weapon forces you to use that weapon for your strike,
I'm not sure on this. Thanks again,

Josh

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <58280l$c...@newsstand.cit.cornell.edu>,


They cannot use the maneuver if they don't get a strike - since
using the maneuver means that they have chosen a strike (which
they are not permitted to do).

Here's a related (kinda) question:

Duck and Ignacio get into combat. (both currently have inf. potence).

No pre ranged effects.

Ignacio (acting minion) declines to maneuver.
Duck maneuvers to long range via thrown gate.
Ignacio maneuvers back to close, also via a thrown gate.
No more maneuvers.

Before strike declaration phase (which I assume still takes place, even though we all
know which strikes will be chosen), Ignacio plays an Immortal Grapple.

Q: a) Can he do this? Or are the strikes considered chosen during the set range
phase?
b) What happens? Only hand strikes may be made against or by the vampire using
IG, but both vamps have to "toss them gates"!

Just another one of those wacky scenarios that cause us to love this game SO much!

Thanks in advance!!!

Messages.Body:

>Here's a related (kinda) question:

>Duck and Ignacio get into combat. (both currently have inf. potence).

>No pre ranged effects.

>Ignacio (acting minion) declines to maneuver.
>Duck maneuvers to long range via thrown gate.
>Ignacio maneuvers back to close, also via a thrown gate.
>No more maneuvers.

>Before strike declaration phase (which I assume still takes place, even though we all
>know which strikes will be chosen), Ignacio plays an Immortal Grapple.

>Q: a) Can he do this? Or are the strikes considered chosen during the set range
>phase?

Yes, he can do this. The strikes aren't chosen, even though both minions
are committed to choosing particular strikes.

> b) What happens? Only hand strikes may be made against or by the vampire using
>IG, but both vamps have to "toss them gates"!

Both strikes (which have been made illegal by the Grapple) will fizzle.
